$about: The one table of environments and their routes. Every contract, guideline, website section and brand asset declares "environment": one or more names below. generate.mjs prints each route in llms.txt; standards.mjs, the pull request check and route-scan.mjs read the same table. Add an environment by adding an entry here, and an item folder by adding a source. {site} is the docs host.

product.label: Product UI
product.summary: The AhaSlides apps people work in: editor, dashboard, settings, admin, presenter controls, docs and internal tools.

route.judge: {site}/anti-slop.md (every product surface: run the binary judge for the surfaces you touch)

audience.label: Audience and presenting canvas
audience.summary: What the audience sees: the phone answer screens and the presenting canvas on the big screen.

route.lint: node node_modules/@ahaslides-product/design/screen-lint.mjs --surface=canvas <presenter files>, then the same command with --surface=audience <audience files> and --surface=settings <settings files>

web.label: Websites
web.summary: Every AhaSlides website page built from full-width sections: landing pages, pricing, blog, careers, campaign and help pages. One design system covers them and the product, so a page can serve both marketing and usability with no seam.

route.judge: {site}/anti-slop.md (every surface the page touches, plus colour and background)

video.label: Video
video.summary: Product videos, explainers, motion graphics and their thumbnails.

route.judge: the aha-mkt skill (Marketing approves its own content)

social-ads.label: Social and ads
social-ads.summary: Social posts, paid ads and other campaign creative outside the websites.

route.judge: the aha-mkt skill (Marketing approves its own content)
